module: "Welcome" window (fg_welcome) of the Flowgraph editor. Displays a header image (welcomeHeader.png), a side image (welcomeSide.png), a left column (new project, open a project, last 10 recent files) and a right introduction column. A "Simple Race" demo project is loaded from flowgraph/examples/scenarios/simpleRace/race.flow.json.
notes: Recent files come from the flowgraph.general.recentFiles preference; only those that still exist (FS:fileExists) are listed.
The window takes focus only once at opening (self.focus).

init.desc: Registers the window (150x300, visible by default), loads the header and side textures, prepares the list of demo projects.

drawLeftColumn.desc: Draws "Projects" (New Project via core_flowgraphManager.addManager, Open Project... via the file dialog) and "Recent Files".

drawContent.desc: Assembles the images and the two columns of the window.

draw.desc: Draws the "Welcome" window if it is visible. Called every frame.
